Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The two Umpires have taken their positions. The Irish fielders have scattered. Ashiqur Rahman Shibli and Adil Bin Siddik will be opening for Bangladesh Under-19. Reuben Wilson to bowl the first over.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Bangladesh Under-19 on the other hand, will be a bit disappointed with their bowling effort. Their star bowler, Maruf Mridha struck first for his team after receiving a couple of warnings as he was following through in the protected area. Their bowling unit was unable to take wickets at regular intervals and allowed a few partnerships in the middle. The spinners got a lot of turn on this pitch and got wickets initially but could not take full advantage of it. They were decent in ground fielding but in the air, they dropped a couple of catches at the important stages of the game which they had to regret later in the innings. Adil Bin Siddik who comes into the team dropped Kian Hilton when he was on 35, and now he will look to make up for it with the bat. Till the end of the innings, Maruf Mridha and Sheikh Paevez Jibon managed to pick up two wickets each for themselves. Md Rafi Uzzaman Rafi, Mahfuzur Rahman, and Md Rohanat Doullah Borson chipped in with one each. They were chasing something similar in their previous game, but their batters fell well short. So, they will need to be careful here too, and build up partnerships to gun this down. Join us in a bit for the second essay.

Scott Macbeth is up for a quick chat. He says it is a competitive total. Praises Kian Hilton for his excellent knock. Tells that it is always difficult when the ball is spinning that much and the chat between him and Hilton was to build up a partnership. Ends by saying that he is excited to bowl on this wicket and hopes that his team will get the win here.

Ireland Under-19 started a bit slowly but will be happy with their overall effort as this total will give their in-form bowlers a lot of confidence to defend it. They batted steadily, but managed to put the loose balls away. The top-order batters were able to form small partnerships but weren't making anything out of it. Jordan Neill was out there from the start initiating the partnerships but got dismissed on the 16th over. Kian Hilton played a brilliant knock and made a half-century which was needed for the team. Scott Macbeth on the other hand supported Kian by giving him the strike and was able to form a sturdy partnership off 77 runs in 100 deliveries. Kian Hilton got some lifelines in the middle of the innings which he made sure to make a profit out of and got dismissed on the 49th over after plugging an immense knock by scoring 90 runs off 113 deliveries. The lower middle order of the team did enough to put a score of X runs on the board to challenge the batters of the Bangla Tigers. Now it's up to the Irish bowling unit as they have a good set of total and they are moving according to their plan as stated by the skipper, Philippus le Roux during the toss interview.

A brilliant batting display from Ireland Under-19! What an innings we have witnessed from Kian Hilton. He anchored the inning exceptionally well by scoring 90 runs off 113 deliveries. The Bangla Tigers would have wanted to keep the Irish under 200, but a few dropped catches has cost them a lot here.
Only a single to end the innings! This is in the blockhole, on middle, Carson McCullough jams it out towards the mid on region for just a single, Ireland Under-19 finish on 235/8!

Commentary.Commentary: Done with the pre-match formalities! The two umpires make their way out to the middle now. We can see the Bangladesh Under-19 players in a huddle and they spread out to take their respective field positions. Jordan Neill and Ryan Hunter are the two openers for Ireland Under-19. Md Rohanat Doullah Borson has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are moments away from the start of the game but before that, the players from both sides stride out and line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Ireland's first followed by the national anthem of Bangladesh.

PITCH REPORT - Abhinav Mukund is pitchside. He says that there is enough moisture to help the pacers upfront. Tells that it is a fresh pitch and the shortest boundary is to the right-hander's leg side while the longest hit is straight. Says that as it is a fresh wicket, the extra spinner for Bangladesh Under-19 can be a good move for them.

Philippus le Roux, the captain of Ireland Under-19 says they were going to bat anyway. Adds that they would like to have a good start in the first innings and the slowness of the pitch could be a key factor in the second innings. He states that the first win was very important for them as each point counts in the group stage. Informs that Matthew Weldon will be playing in place of Harry Dyer as he reckons this pitch is good for seamers.

Mahfuzur Rahman, the skipper of Bangladesh Under-19 says that they will bowl first. Adds that the wicket is good for chasing and their pace bowlers are in good shape so they want to make the most out of it. He continues that they want to win the match and they are in the process as the coaches are guiding them a lot. He also states that the players have gained experience out of the last match and they are confident enough for this game. Informs that they have made two changes and are going with an extra spinner. Adil Bin Siddik and Md Rafi Uzzaman Rafi come in the team for Jishan Alam and Md Iqbal Hasan Emon respectively.

Ireland Under-19 (Playing XI) - Jordan Neill, Ryan Hunter (WK), Gavin Roulston, Kian Hilton, Philippus le Roux (C), Scott Macbeth, John McNally, Carson McCullough, Oliver Riley, Reuben Wilson, Matthew Weldon (In place of Harry Dyer).

Bangladesh Under-19 (Playing XI) - Ashiqur Rahman Shibli (WK), Adil Bin Siddik (In place of Jishan Alam), Chowdhury Md Rizwan, Ariful Islam, Ahrar Amin, Md Shihab James, Mahfuzur Rahman (C), Sheikh Paevez Jibon, Md Rafi Uzzaman Rafi (In place of Md Iqbal Hasan Emon), Md Rohanat Doullah Borson, Maruf Mridha.
TOSS - The coin lands in favour of Bangladesh Under-19 and they have elected to BOWL first.

Bangladesh Under-19, on the other hand, fell short against Ind-U19 in their opening fixture. Their batting let them down massively and they will need to improve quickly. Even though the result did not go their way, there were a couple of positives as Md. Shihab James scored a gritty half-century and Maruf Mridha took a brilliant fifer. They will be hoping to execute their plans better in this one and open their tally in the World Cup. Let's see who comes out on top. Toss and team news in a bit.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the match between Ireland Under-19 and Bangladesh Under-19 at the Mangaung Oval in Bloemfontein. The stakes are high and a win for the Bangla Tigers will make things interesting in Group A while the Irish can seal qualification with a victory.
... MATCHDAY ...

The ICC Under-19 World Cup in Group A features a crucial encounter between Ireland Under-19 and Bangladesh Under-19. Ireland showcased brilliance in their opening game, securing a dominating win against USA-U19, propelled by their effective bowlers. Reuben Wilson, with prior tournament experience, demonstrated pace and swing, while Olly Riley, his opening partner and best friend, showcased his fast bowling skills as both them caused havoc for the batters. John McNally provides support and excels at delivering breakthroughs in the middle overs. Carson McCullough and Scott Macbeth effectively handle the spin department. Batting relies on Ryan Hunter, who scored a maiden fifty in the previous game, skipper Philippus le Roux, and Kian Hilton who got runs under their belts as well. However, Jordan Neill and Gavin Roulston in the top order aim to contribute more. Bangladesh Under-19 faced a contrasting result with a significant defeat against India-U19. Their batting struggled, particularly the top order with Ashiqur Rahman Shibli, Jishan Alam, and Rizwan Chowdhury needing to step up. Md. Shihab James and Ariful Islam showed promise, with the former registering a half-century, but lacked adequate support. Maruf Mridha's five-wicket haul highlighted their decent bowling performance. Md Iqbal Hasan Emon, Md. Rohanat Doullah Borson, and Sheikh Paevez Jibon must step up to complement the bowling attack. Despite a challenging start, Bangladesh remains confident after defeating Australia in the warm-up game, showcasing their capability to challenge top teams. The encounter holds significance for both teams as Bangladesh Under-19 seeks two crucial points, while Ireland Under-19 aims to secure a second consecutive win for qualification. The outcome of this battle will unfold on the field, determining which team emerges victorious.
